notes: Restored brick railway station (Estación del Ferrocarril de Bolívar / Estación Montoya) in Barrio Abajo: exposed brick walls, yellow quoins, green wooden doors/shutters, red metal awnings and hipped roof. photo-1: full three-quarter view of the corner elevation with octagonal corner bay and Barranquilla heritage plaque visible. photo-2: closer oblique view of the upper facade where the 'ESTACION MONTOYA' lettering is clearly legible. A third Commons candidate ('File:Estacion Montoya.jpg', 550x366) returned an HTML error page on download and was discarded.
